block.nexus.waxed_redstone.tooltip: Redstone Block limited to one facing side
block.nexus.waxed_redstone.guide: Uses max 15 redstone power similar to a Redstone block. Facing state based on where you face when item is used. Only one face of the block is powered
block.nexus.flint_block.guide: Crafting material compressed from nine flint
block.nexus.compressed_cobblestone.toolt: Crafting material compressed from nine cobblestone
block.nexus.compressed_cobblestone.guide: Crafting material compressed from nine cobblestone
item.nexus.milk_bottle.tooltip: All the benefits of Milk in a smaller package
item.nexus.milk_bottle.guide: Applies the milk curative effect to the player, removing most harmful effects
item.nexus.fireball.guide: Throwable like a fire charge.  Crafting ingredient
item.nexus.fireball_dark.guide: Throwable like a fire charge.  Crafting ingredient
item.nexus.shield_flint.tooltip: Slightly more durable than a traditional wooden shield.
item.nexus.shield_flint.guide: Slightly more durable than a traditional wooden shield.
item.nexus.shield_leather.tooltip: More durable than a traditional wooden shield.
item.nexus.shield_leather.guide: More durable than a traditional wooden shield.
item.nexus.shield_bone.tooltip: More durable than a leather shield.
item.nexus.shield_bone.guide: More durable than a leather shield.
item.nexus.shield_obsidian.tooltip: Significantly more durable than a traditional wooden shield.
item.nexus.shield_obsidian.guide: Significantly more durable than a traditional wooden shield.
item.nexus.flute_summoning.tooltip: Tap on a specific entity to summon it later
item.nexus.flute_summoning.guide: Saves the ID of a target entity on use.  Then if you use it later it will attempt to summon the entity to you, if the dimensions match
block.nexus.altar_destruction.guide: Cancel damage and desturction of nearby explosions
block.nexus.glass_connected.guide: Connected textures, similar to compressed glass
block.nexus.no_soliciting.tooltip: Prevent spawns of some harmless annoying creatures
block.nexus.no_soliciting.guide: Nearby natural spawns of the specified mob types (bats, traders, trader llamas) will not spawn.  Only runs when blockstate is lit, interact to disable.
block.nexus.sponge_lava.tooltip: Eats up nearby lava source blocks
block.nexus.sponge_lava.guide: Place and wait for some time to let it soak up nearby lava.  Source lava is not recoverable, it is deleted by the sponge
block.nexus.sponge_milk.tooltip: When placed it clears all potions from nearby entities
block.nexus.sponge_milk.guide: When placed it will clear potions from creatures and players in the area.  Break and replace to trigger again
block.nexus.teleport.guide: Place and feed with energy.  Use a GPS Location device to track a target destination for the teleport.  Crouch to use
block.nexus.crusher.tooltip: Grind up materials or break down components
block.nexus.crusher.guide: Grinding recipes sometimes have a chance for a bonus extra product
block.nexus.battery_clay.tooltip: Small energy storage holds up to 16k
block.nexus.battery_clay.guide: Holds 16,000RF.  When powered with redstone this block will output power down if possible
block.nexus.doorbell.guide: Light level 4 and redstone power of 1 while pressed.  Plays sound nexus:doorbell_mikekoenig
block.nexus.trash.tooltip: Deletes all items and fluids piped into it
block.nexus.trash.guide: Deletes all items and fluids piped into it.
block.nexus.trash.guide0: Warning! There's no undo button. Once the item's gone, it's gone.
block.nexus.experience_pylon.tooltip: Collects nearby XP orbs, players above
block.nexus.experience_pylon.guide: The Experience Pylon automatically collects nearby experience orbs and stores them as Fluid Experience in its internal buffer. Fluid Experience can be pumped into and out of the pylon.
item.nexus.experience_food.guide: Created by using the Experience Pylon, and the Solidifier.  Eat the confection to gain the experience held within, or use it on an Experience Pylon to put experience back into the pylon.
item.nexus.charm_stone.tooltip: Immune to suffocation & elytra crash damage
item.nexus.charm_stone.guide: Prevents damage when elytra crashing into walls.  Also suffocation if you noClip or teleport into solid wall of blocks
item.nexus.charm_attack_speed.guide: Increase attack speed.  This causes the recovery bar by the crosshairs to recover faster for increased damage overall.  Default is 50 percent increase, depends on config file.
item.nexus.charm_luck.guide: Increase players passive luck attribute, which affects some loot tables such as mobs, fishing, treasure chests.  Default is 10 points, depends on config file
item.nexus.charm_xp_blocker.guide: Blocks pickup of XP Orbs.  They are still attracted to and float around the player
item.nexus.charm_xp_speed.tooltip: Pickup XP Orbs as fast as possible
item.nexus.charm_xp_speed.guide: Pickup XP Orbs as fast as possible by removing the internal cooldown on pickup
item.nexus.charm_knockback_resistance.gu: Immune to knockback; when you take damage the player will not be moved
item.nexus.quiver_lightning.tooltip: Living targets have a 25% chance of retribution
item.nexus.quiver_lightning.guide: When arrow hits a living target, randomly decides to summon a lightning bolt on the target
item.nexus.quiver_damage.guide: Arrow damage increased while this is worn in inventory or curios.  Can be disabled with right click just like other baubles
item.nexus.charm_venom.tooltip: Attacks have 25% chance to poison target
item.nexus.charm_venom.guide: When damage dealt from the player as a source, this adds a chance to give the poison potion effect for a few seconds on the target
item.nexus.charm_water.guide: Prevent drowning damage after air is empty
item.nexus.charm_starvation.tooltip: Immune to damage and death by starvation
item.nexus.charm_starvation.guide: Immune to damage and death by starvation
item.nexus.charm_invisible.guide: Applies the invisibility potion effect like a beacon would
item.nexus.charm_boostpotion.guide: Potion duration increased when consumed, while this is worn in inventory or curios.  Can be disabled with right click just like other baubles
item.nexus.charm_magicdefense.guide: All magic that wearer takes is reduced while this is worn in inventory or curios.  Can be disabled with right click just like other baubles
item.nexus.charm_stealthpotion.guide: Disables potion particles at the moment you gain the effect, or drink the potion.  Does not work on existing effects, so if you drink a potion and then equip it does not know
item.nexus.charm_antipotion.guide: Potion duration is nullified at the time of consumption.  Treats positive and negative effects the same.  Ignores instant effects
item.nexus.charm_longfall.guide: Immune to fall damage, and cactus and sweetberry damage
item.nexus.crafting_stick.guide: Handheld crafting table.  Does not preserve its inventory
item.nexus.crafting_bag.guide: Handheld crafting table with an inventory that is saved in itself like a backpack
block.nexus.terra_glass.tooltip: Reactive to sunlight, promotes crop growth
block.nexus.terra_glass.guide: Reacts to sunlight if it is in direct contact.  Produces light and lights up crops when in the sun.
block.nexus.detector_weather.tooltip: Redstone output level depends on weather
block.nexus.detector_weather.guide: Full power when thunderstorm, half power in the rain
block.nexus.detector_moon.tooltip: Redstone output level depends on phase of the moon
block.nexus.detector_moon.guide: The eight phases of the moon each output a different power level
block.nexus.rotator.tooltip: Rotates targeted block when triggered with redstone
block.nexus.rotator.guide: Triggers when redstone power goes from off to on.  Rotates common valid block states
block.nexus.eye_teleport.tooltip: Look and crouch to teleport onto it
block.nexus.eye_teleport.guide: Whenever a player is looking at this while crouching, the player is teleported on top of this block.  If solid blocks are above it, there is some leeway where you will appear above all of those blocks.  Same logic as Ender Scepter.  Can cost hunger and experience based on config values.
block.nexus.ghost.guide: While this block has redstone power, it is not selectable or breakable, and all entities pass through it.  It is also completely invisible.  Remove the power to break it.
block.nexus.ghost_phantom.guide: While this block has redstone power, it is not selectable or breakable, and all entities pass through it.  Remove the power to break it.
block.nexus.hopper.guide: Moves items one per tick with similar logic to regular hoppers.  Is disabled with redstone.  Collects only from the area directly above the hopper
block.nexus.hopper_gold.guide: Moves items 64 per tick with similar logic to regular hoppers.  Is disabled with redstone.  Collects only from the area directly above the hopper
block.nexus.hopper_fluid.guide: Moves fluids one bucket per tick with similar logic to regular hoppers.  Is disabled with redstone.  Collects only from the area directly above the hopper
block.nexus.eye_redstone.tooltip: Redstone powered while a player is looking
block.nexus.eye_redstone.guide: This block detects nearby players, and checks their eye position to see if the player is looking at the block.  Whenever its being looked at, the blockstate is updated and it produces redstone power.
block.nexus.collector.guide: The Collector picks up nearby items and stores them in its internal buffer. Items can be taken directly out of the buffer, or piped out.
block.nexus.cask.guide: The Cask is a small tank for storing fluids.Fluids can be inserted and removed both by pipes and by buckets and other handheld fluid containers.
block.nexus.flower_purple_tulip.guide: May spawn in the following biome Categories: river, savanna, underground, mesa, forest, mushroom
block.nexus.flower_absalon_tulip.guide: May spawn in the following biome Categories: river, plains, taiga, underground, mesa, jungle
block.nexus.flower_lime_carnation.guide: May spawn in the following biome Categories: river, beach, ocean, icy, extreme hills, jungle
block.nexus.flower_cyan.guide: A lost legacy from a lost version of Minecraft.  Spawns alone in biome categories: forest, plains, taiga, extreme hills).
block.nexus.apple_sprout.guide: Plant below a leaf block to grow an apple.
block.nexus.apple_sprout_emerald.guide: Plant below a leaf block to grow an emerald apple.
block.nexus.apple_sprout_diamond.guide: Plant below a leaf block to grow a diamond apple.
block.nexus.apple_sprout_chocolate.guide: Plant below a leaf block to grow an apple.
item.nexus.scythe_harvest.guide: Harvest the area on use.  Sneak to harvest a smaller area.  Uses the same logic as the Harvester block.
item.nexus.location_data.tooltip: Saves the location of a block
item.nexus.location_data.guide: Right click on a block with the GPS Marker in hand to save its position to the Marker.Markers with saved locations can be used in multiple machines from this mod such as Shape Builder .
block.nexus.computer_shape.tooltip: Read buildings into a Shape Card
block.nexus.computer_shape.guide: Place two  GPS Card cards and one  Shape Card, then you can read, copy, paste, and merge shapes together.
item.nexus.entity_data.guide: Store data on an entity-type, such as minecraft:sheep and the data tags.  Used in: Fan, Pharos Beacon
item.nexus.blockstate_data.tooltip: Use to remember target block or blockstate
item.nexus.blockstate_data.guide: Use on a block to read and remember its block state.  Crouch while using to filter on the block only.  Can store a list of 18 blockstates.  Craft to erase the list.  It can distinguish between identical blocks in different states such as rotated stairs, double slabs, etc if in exact [blockstate] mode. Used for machine filters, See Miner
item.nexus.filter_data.tooltip: Holds items and settings used for filters
item.nexus.filter_data.guide: Fill with items to adjust machine or cable settings that are filtered
item.nexus.shape_data.tooltip: Builds in-world after setup in a Shape Computer
item.nexus.shape_data.guide: Place in a Shape Computer or a Shape Builder to load with data, then click on a block to load its block
item.nexus.sound_data.tooltip: Use to play the recorded sound
item.nexus.sound_data.guide: Record nearby sounds and play them later.  See matching machines for details
block.nexus.sound_recorder.tooltip: Records sounds; save into Sound Data Cards
block.nexus.sound_recorder.guide: Record any sounds up to 8 blocks away, and record in the block.  Comes with an ignore list that you can build up.  Save to Sound Data Card for use in Sound Player.
block.nexus.lamp.tooltip: Light level depends on redstone input
block.nexus.lamp.guide: Light level depends on how much redstone power is given.  Max power is max light, a weak redstone signal is almost no light
block.nexus.membrane.tooltip: Walk on this while its wet
block.nexus.membrane.guide: Becomes wet similar to farmland while it is touching water.  Walking across the wet version will provide a brief speed and jump boost
block.nexus.cloud.guide: Whenever passing through, applies short slowness buff and removes current built up pending fall damage
block.nexus.cloud_membrane.tooltip: Solid for anything not a player
block.nexus.cloud_membrane.guide: Solid for most mobs, but players can pass through like air
block.nexus.soil.tooltip: Keeps nearby Farmland damp without any water
block.nexus.soil.guide: Nearby farmland treats this just like water, and will become and stay damp
block.nexus.sound_player.tooltip: Plays sounds recorded on Sound Cards
block.nexus.sound_player.guide: Play any sound recorded onto a Sound Data Card
item.nexus.shape_data.state: Empty block, select one with a click first
item.nexus.shape_data.nothing: Card requires a shape and a selected block
item.nexus.settings_data.guide: Copy settings between nexus machines.  Hit on bedrock to wipe data clean.  After data is copied, can only be put onto blocks with the same id.
block.nexus.terra_preta.tooltip: Place below farmland for sprinkler-like growth
block.nexus.terra_preta.guide: Place Terra Preta below farmland to increase the speed at which crops grow.  Works just like a sprinkler except there are no particles, and it only targets the block above.
block.nexus.crate.tooltip: Reinforced and keeps contents when broken
block.nexus.crate.guide: The Crate is a container, like a chest, that is reinforced to survive explosions and wither attacks.
block.nexus.crate_mini.guide: The Crate is a container, like a chest, that is reinforced to survive explosions. Can be waterlogged
block.nexus.dark_glass.tooltip: Immune to light, explosions, and wither blasts
block.nexus.dark_glass.guide: Dark Glass, unlike regular glass it does not allow light to pass through. It's also immune explosions including those caused by the Wither. See connected version
block.nexus.dark_glass_connected.tooltip: Immune to light, explosions, and wither blasts
block.nexus.dark_glass_connected.guide: Self-connecting textures. Unlike regular glass, does not let light pass through.Oh, and it's also immune explosions, including those caused by the Wither.
block.nexus.light_camo.tooltip: Sneak-left-click anything to make it render a facade block
block.nexus.light_camo.guide: Produces light, and copies a block appearance.
block.nexus.soundproofing_ghost.guide: Sneak-left-click anything to make it render a facade block
block.nexus.soundproofing_ghost.tooltip: Use block on it to copy appearance.  Works exactly the same as regular soundproofing
block.nexus.soundproofing.guide: Place to reduce the volume of nearby sounds in the world.  Multiple blocks stack together, and can be placed in close proximity for a stronger effect.  Break block or use redstone power to disable.  Config file has a setting for the radius.
block.nexus.fan.guide: The Fan is a configurable machine designed to push players, mobs, items and other entities.Right-click on a fan to configure its range and speed.
block.nexus.fan_slab.guide: The Fan Slab is a simple block machine designed to push players, mobs, items and other entities.
block.nexus.peace_candle.guide: Prevents natural hostile mob spawns in a large radius including above and below (see config for values).  Interact to light or disable.
block.nexus.water_candle.guide: The Water Candle can be lit by a player to increase the rate at which mobs naturally spawn nearby.For the candle to work, mobs must be able to spawn naturally in its vicinity.In most cases, this means it must be dark enough to spawn mobs!
block.nexus.water_candle.guide0: When lit, has a random chance to extinguish itself while spawning a mob. When this happens, you must relight the candle for it to continue spawning.
block.nexus.unbreakable_block.tooltip: Right-click with Redstone to toggle Unbreakable state
block.nexus.unbreakable_block.guide: Place in the world and then right-click with Redstone dust, Redstone Torch, or a Redstone Block in hand to toggle whether this block can be broken.
block.nexus.unbreakable_reactive.tooltip: Unbreakable while it has redstone power, can mine it otherwise
block.nexus.unbreakable_reactive.guide: By default this can be mined as normal.  If it ever has a redstone signal given to it, then it becomes unbreakable by the block state. Unlike the other unbreakable block, this one uses a Tile Entity.
block.nexus.conveyor.tooltip: Set speed with redstone torch, rotation type with wrench, color with dye
block.nexus.conveyor.guide: Moves all entities standing on it.   Many properties of this block are stored in the blockstate such as type, speed, and dye color.  Types include straight, corner, and up/down ramps.  To toggle the type, place in world and use the Wooden Wrench on the placed rail, this toggles the type.
block.nexus.conveyor.guide0: Hold a redstone torch and interact to toggle the speed.   Hold dye and use it on the block to toggle the color.  These updates propogate to nearby connected rails.  (check F3 to view these properties in detail)
block.nexus.ender_item_shelf.guide: Stores 5 slots items.  Use any normal Wrench to toggle display mode, or a Rotation Tool to rotate its facing direction
block.nexus.ender_shelf.guide: Stores 5 stacks of enchanted books. This also counts as a bookshelf for Enchanting tables. A Each shelf accepts books with exactly 1 enchantment on them, slots that you can right click on to insert or withdraw a Enchanted Book from storage.  Use any normal Wrench to toggle display mode, or a Rotation Tool to rotate its facing direction
block.nexus.ender_shelf.guide0: Enchanted Books must have just one enchantment to be inserted. Use a Disenchanter to strip books down to single enchantments if necessary. Use mixed books on the Controller.
block.nexus.ender_controller.guide: When combined with at least one Ender Shelf, allows for automated insertion/extraction of Enchanted books. Can accept mixed Enchanted Books
block.nexus.workbench.tooltip: A Crafting Table that keeps its inventory when closed
block.nexus.workbench.guide: A simple Crafting Table that keeps its inventory when closed.
item.nexus.flippers.guide: When worn, Flippers increase the player's swim speed.Can be equipped as an accessory if the Curios mod is installed.
item.nexus.glove_climb.guide: When worn, Climbing Gloves allow the player to climb vertical surfaces as if a ladder or vines were present.Can be equipped as an accessory if the Curios mod is installed.
block.nexus.breaker.tooltip: Breaks blocks placed in front of it
block.nexus.breaker.guide: Breakers can be used to break the block placed directly in front of it, like a player would.Breakers do not have internal item storage, so the broken block will drop itself (or its loot) in the world to be picked up.
item.nexus.rotation_wand.guide: Its not really a wrench, see the data tags.  This sipmle tool can be used to rotate simple blocks such as stairs, slabs, and similar compatible blocks that face certain directions.  Try hitting blocks from different angles
item.nexus.cable_wrench.tooltip: Use to make cables extract, crouch and use to block cables
item.nexus.cable_wrench.guide: Use this cable Wrench by right-clicking on a nexus cable to change the cable's settings such as import filter, blocked, normal.  Blocked state only appears while player is sneaking/crouching.  Works on compatible blocks using the forge:tools/wrench data tag
item.nexus.build_scepter.guide: The Building Scepter is a powerful tool that comes in three forms - Fill, Place, and Exchange.For each, left clicking on any block will change the size of the area that will be affected. Sneak-left-clicking will select the block to be placed by the scepter. Right-click with the scepter to place or exchange blocks from your inventory.
item.nexus.build_scepter.guide0: $(li)The Fill Scepter places blocks in the specified-shape around the block you right-click on.$(li)The Exchange Scepter swaps all blocks with your selected block in a shape around the block you right-click.$(li)The Place Scepter is similar to the Fill Scepter, except the blocks are placed on the surface of the block you right-click.
item.nexus.randomize_scepter.tooltip: Randomly shuffle around the blocks in a 5x5x1 area around the target block
item.nexus.randomize_scepter.guide: Randomly shuffle around the blocks in a 5x5x1 area around the target block
button.filter.ignoredamage1.tooltip: Ignore damage and match only on item
button.build.first.tooltip: Use blocks left to right as normal
button.build.random.tooltip: Use a random block each time
button.build.rotate.tooltip: Use blocks one by one in a pattern
button.harvester.mode.tooltip: Area will attempt to harvest the whole area at once at the cost of fuel
button.rotations.up: Number of times to rotate the block (for stairs and such)
button.rotations.down: Number of times to rotate the block (for stairs and such)
command.nexus.arguments.null: Second argument must be a valid nexus command:
command.nexus.gethome.bed: Your home bed was missing or obstructed
command.nexus.home.overworld: You must be in The Overworld to teleport to your bed
command.nexus.home.nether: You must be in The Nether to teleport to your Respawn Anchor
command.nexus.home.obstructed: Your respawn point is missing or obstructed
command.nexus.searchitem.none: No items found within search radius
command.nexus.searchtrade.none: No matching trades found in nearby villagers
enchantment.nexus.laststand.desc: Prevents killing blows at the cost of experience
enchantment.nexus.laststand.guide: Leg armor by design. If you take lethal damage, and have enough EXP points to spare (30 default at level 1) then the damage is mostly prevented leaving you at 1/2 heart and the experience points are spent. Not compatible with mending, xp boost, launch, thorns
enchantment.nexus.excavate.desc: Harvests the whole vein of connected matching blocks, not including diagonals
enchantment.nexus.excavate.guide: Randomly reaches out in all direction and mines blocks matching the original target.  Higher levels have more [ maximum_blocks = 26 + 8 * ENCHANT_LEVEL]
enchantment.nexus.multishot.desc: Fires extra horizontal arrows from your bow
enchantment.nexus.multishot.guide: Bow enchantment that adds extra arrows to the left and right of your bow shot.  They show up to the left and right relative to the main arrow.
enchantment.nexus.beheading.guide: This gives a chance for getting a mob head or a player head.  Creatures from other mods can be added in the config file, and need a players skin as a head.
enchantment.nexus.beheading.desc: This gives a chance for getting a mob head or a player head.  Creatures from other mods can be added in the config file, and need a players skin as a head.
enchantment.nexus.experience_boost.desc: Increases experience drops from killing and mining
enchantment.nexus.experience_boost.guide: Whenever mining a block that drops experience orbs, it increases by a random number based on enchant level.  Whenever a Living creature dies and drops experience, if it was killed by the attacking player more exp is dropped randomly based on level
enchantment.nexus.growth.guide: Grow nearby crops while held.  Radius is level + 2.  Passive aura type buff, no need to use the tool.  Can be applied to Hoe tools only.
enchantment.nexus.launch.desc: Gives you the power of multi jump (double jump) when enchanted on boots or elytra.  One extra jump per level, after that cooldown kicks in; sneak to jump normally.
enchantment.nexus.launch.guide: Gives you the power of multi jump (double jump) when enchanted on boots or elytra.  One extra jump per level, after that cooldown kicks in; sneak to jump normally.
enchantment.nexus.life_leech.desc: Leeches life points from your target on attack, and even more on kill.
enchantment.nexus.life_leech.guide: Leeches life points from your target on attack, and even more on kill.  Can only apply to weapons only (swords).
enchantment.nexus.magnet.desc: Makes you magnetic for item stacks and experience on the ground
enchantment.nexus.magnet.guide: Makes you magnetic for item stacks and experience on the ground.  Magnet only triggers while item is held/equipped.  Can apply to anything.
enchantment.nexus.quickshot.desc: This triples the speed that your bow draws up to full power.
enchantment.nexus.quickshot.guide: This triples the speed that your bow draws up to full power.  Higher levels further increase draw speed.  Applies to regular bows, not crossbows.
enchantment.nexus.reach.desc: Increases your building and mining reach
enchantment.nexus.reach.guide: Increases your building and mining reach.  Can apply to chestplate armor or Elytra
enchantment.nexus.step.desc: Increases your step height to a full block, (applies to boots only)
enchantment.nexus.step.guide: Increases your step height to a full block, similar to horses. (Can be applied to boots only)
enchantment.nexus.traveler.desc: Protects against exploration hazards (elytra, ender pearls, cacti, bees, fall resistance)
enchantment.nexus.traveler.guide: Protects against exploration hazards (elytra, ender pearls, cacti, bees, fall resistance).  (Can be applied to leg armor only)
enchantment.nexus.venom.desc: Inflicts the poison status effect on the target
enchantment.nexus.venom.guide: Inflicts the poison status effect on the target.  Can apply to swords only
enchantment.nexus.steady.guide: Combat knockback events are cancelled while wearing at least one level on this anywhere (does not stack)
enchantment.nexus.auto_smelt.desc: Smelts whatever you harvest with this tool.
enchantment.nexus.auto_smelt.guide: Smelts whatever you harvest with this tool.  Can apply to mining tools such as axes, shovels, pickaxes.  Not compatible with fortune or silk touch
enchantment.nexus.disarm.desc: Chance to disarm opponent on hit.
enchantment.nexus.disarm.guide: Chance to disarm opponent on hit.  Can apply to swords only
enchantment.nexus.curse.desc: Chance to apply negative status effects to enemy when hit. Chance does not stack with multiple enchanted items.
enchantment.nexus.curse.guide: Chance to apply negative status effects to enemy when hit. Chance does not stack with multiple enchanted items.  Can apply to any armor piece
enchantment.nexus.ender.desc: Throws an Ender Pearl with your sword, consuming durability. Cooldown decreases with level.
enchantment.nexus.ender.guide: Throws an Ender Pearl with your sword, consuming durability. Cooldown decreases with level.  Can apply to swords only
enchantment.nexus.beekeeper.desc: Protection against thorny and flying damage.
enchantment.nexus.beekeeper.guide: Protection against thorny and flying damage.  First level prevent bee, bat, and llama spit damage.  Level II or higher prevents phantom damage.
fluid.nexus.biomass.guide: Combine solid Biomass with various organic material in a Melter to create Fluid Biomass.
fluid.nexus.honey.guide: Fluid Honey can be extracted from honey byproducts in a Melting Chamber and is used in a Solidification Chamber.
fluid.nexus.wax.guide: An empty honeycomb can be melted into wax.  See recipes in Melting Chamber and Solidification Chamber.
fluid.nexus.magma.guide: Fluid Magma can be extracted from Magma Blocks or Magma Cream in a  Melting Chamber and is used in a Solidification Chamber.
fluid.nexus.slime.guide: Fluid Slime can be extracted from Slimeballs or Slime Blocks in a  Melting Chamber and is used in a Solidification Chamber.
fluid.nexus.xpjuice.guide: Fluid Experience is created and used by the Experience Pylon.
gui.enderbook.title: Ender Book Waypoints
guide.category.accessories.desc: These accessories all provide passive abilities to the player; and do not need to be held in the hand or activated.  They are all supported by the Curios mod if installed.
guide.category.blocks.desc: These are all the simple (non-machine) blocks in nexus.
guide.category.consume.desc: These are single use items; either consumed by the player or a targeted creature.
guide.category.machines.desc: Machines are active tile-entity blocks.  They usually have an inventory screen, and consume energy or fluids.
guide.category.enchantments.desc: Enchantments can all be applied normally through anvils or enchanting tables.
guide.category.gear.desc: Basic equipment such as armor, tools, and swords.
guide.category.misc.desc: Items that don't fit into other categories.
guide.category.items.desc: All these tools have a unique purpose.  Most are tools that can be used many times and are not consumeable.  Many take durability damage as they get used.
guide.category.potions.desc: Potions can all be brewed normally in a brewing stand based on awkward base potions.
guide.title: nexus Guidebook
item.nexus.ender_book.guide: A magical book that stores your current location as a waypoint.   Crouch and scroll to pick location.  Crouch and use to teleport.  Jump to cancel the port.  Repair with energy or ender pearls
item.nexus.ender_book.tooltip: Crouch to teleport or scroll through locations
item.cantoggle.guide: Right click this item in your inventory to toggle it on or off.
item.iscurios.guide: If the Curios mod is installed, this item can be worn as an accessory.
item.nexus.carbon_paper.tooltip: Copy sign contents, clean on a cauldron
item.nexus.carbon_paper.guide: Carbon Paper can be used to copy the contents of one sign to another. The copied text can be cleaned off of the Carbon Paper by using it on a Cauldron.
item.nexus.antigravity.tooltip: Ignore gravity and walk on air
item.nexus.antigravity.guide: When active, you can jump without falling at the expense of durability while you remain in the air.
item.nexus.charm_antidote.guide: When in your inventory or worn as an accessory, protects you from poison at the expense of durability.
item.nexus.charm_wither.guide: When in your inventory or worn as an accessory, protects you from the Wither status effect at the expense of durability.
item.nexus.charm_ultimate.tooltip: Poison, wither, fire, lava, and void protection
item.nexus.charm_ultimate.guide: When in your inventory or worn as an accessory, combines the protection effects of the Antidote Charm, Wither Charm, Fire Charm, and Void Charm.
item.charm_boat.guide: Increases your rowing speed in a boat.  Right click in your inventory to turn it off.  Compatible with baubles API.
item.nexus.charm_fire.guide: When in your inventory or worn as an accessory, protects you from fire damage at the expense of durability.
item.nexus.charm_speed.guide: Gives you a passive speed boost, can be stacked with speed potions.  Default is 50 percent boost, depends on config file.  Right click in your inventory to turn it off.
item.nexus.charm_void.guide: Works in your inventory or in a Baubles slot.  This charm saves you from the void; it detects if you have fallen down below y=-30 and teleports you way up into the sky instead.
item.nexus.charm_void.tooltip: Saves you from falling into the void
item.charm_water.guide: This gives you water breathing effect if it finds you running out of air.  Right click in your inventory to turn it off.  Compatible with baubles API.
item.nexus.charm_wing.guide: Protects you from falling long distances.  If this is on when you fall more than six blocks, it gives you a short burst of the Slowfall potion effect, which is just like a parachute.  Right click in your inventory to turn it off.
item.nexus.charm_wing.tooltip: Grants slowfall after falling far enough
item.nexus.tile_transporter.guide: Right click on any machine or container with the Sack of Holding to pick it up.Right click on any block with a filled Sack of Holding to place the machine again.
item.nexus.tile_transporter_empty.toolti: Transport a container with its contents
item.crafting_food.guide: Unlock a permanent 3x3 crafting table inside your inventory.  Once unlocked, you can open it with a keybinding or with a button in your inventory.
item.nexus_wand.shifting: Use the mouse wheel while sneaking to rotate
item.nexus_wand.guide: Advanced long range building tool.  Has a custom HUD to change the direction (sneak and mouse wheel) Fill its inventory with blocks to build with.  Has different building modes: Random, Pattern, and Normal.
item.dropper_minecart.guide: Its inventory is the same as a Dropper.  Use an activator rail to make it drop one of its items.
item.dropper_minecart.tooltip: Drops an item when it hits an activator rail
item.dynamite_mining.guide: This creates a powerful explosion that does not hurt players or mobs.  It does break blocks, but unlike regular explosions no blocks are lost, so it acts like mining.
item.dynamite_mining.tooltip: Drops 100% of blocks broken as items.  Does not hurt anything living.
item.dynamite_safe.guide: This creates a powerful explosion that does not destroy blocks or hurt creatures.
item.dynamite_safe.tooltip: Does not break blocks or hurt players
item.nexus.emerald_gear.guide: Equipment and armor made from Emeralds. Stronger than diamond equipment.
item.nexus.ender_eye_reuse.tooltip: Reuseable ender eye for finding strongholds
item.nexus.ender_eye_reuse.guide: Reuseable Ender Eye for finding strongholds. Can be thrown multiple times and will not break.
item.nexus.fire_scepter.tooltip: Magic wand with a triple fire shot
item.nexus.fire_scepter.guide: Launch three projectiles that burn and damage entities.  Does not set fire to the world.
item.nexus.spawner_seeker.guide: The Spawner Seeker can be used to find the nearest spawner to your current location.
item.nexus.ender_fishing.tooltip: Throw in the water to fish
item.nexus.ender_fishing.guide: When time this lands in water it tries to catch a fish from current loot tables.  One consumed on each throw.  Ignores the treasure loot tables, so only junk and fish.
item.nexus.lightning_scepter.guide: Launch a projectile that will spawn a natural lightning bolt when it lands.
item.nexus.ender_pearl_mounted.tooltip: Reuseable ender pearl that carries you
item.nexus.ender_pearl_mounted.guide: An enhanced Ender Pearl that also carries the user when thrown.
item.nexus.ender_pearl_reuse.guide: An Ender Pearl that can be thrown, picked up, and thrown again.
item.nexus.ice_scepter.tooltip: Shoot ice that will freeze enemies
item.nexus.ice_scepter.guide: Launch three frozen projectiles that applies the paralyze potion effect to all enemies
item.nexus.ender_tnt_1.guide: Throw these to make explosions.  There are six different levels of power.  These are standard normal explosions with no special properties.
item.nexus.ender_tnt_4.guide: 1/3 power of charged creeper; Same strength as TNT
item.nexus.ender_tnt_4.tooltip: 1/3 power of charged creeper; Same strength as TNT
item.nexus.ender_tnt_6.guide: Same power as charged creeper; Same strength as Ender Crystal
item.nexus.ender_tnt_6.tooltip: Same power as charged creeper; Same strength as Ender Crystal
item.nexus.ender_torch.guide: A throwable torch. This places a torch in the world wherever it lands.
item.nexus.ender_water.guide: Vaporize nearby liquid, three modes of water, lava, generic liquid
item.nexus.ender_wool.guide: Throw a bunch of these at a herd of sheeep to shear them all at a distance.  Gives a slight bonus to wool drops compared to regular shears.
item.nexus.evoker_fang.tooltip: Summons the secret magic of the Evoker Illager
item.nexus.evoker_fang.guide: Summons a beam of Evoker Fangs in whatever direction youre facing.  Must be used on an entity or a block.
item.nexus.fire_dark.guide: Does not burn players or destroy blocks.
item.nexus.fire_killer.guide: Extinguish all nearby fire based on the fire data tag.
item.nexus.apple_lofty_stature.guide: Eating increases your step height to a full block like a horse (eat again to undo)
item.nexus.apple_lofty_stature.tooltip: Eating increases your step height to a full block like a horse (eat again to undo)
item.nexus.chorus_flight.guide: A balanced way to get the power of flight.  Gives you a few (stackable) minutes of creative flight each time its eaten.  Use milk to remove.
item.nexus.chorus_spectral.guide: Eat this to phase through walls for a few seconds. Does not include flight, you will fall into the void without extra items or abilities, and you can get stuck inside a wall
item.nexus.glowing_helmet.guide: Enables glowing night vision while worn
item.nexus.heart.guide: When consumed, grants the player 1 permanent, extra heart. Multiple can be consumed for additional hearts.  Config file specifies the maximum number of hearts allowed, default is 20.
item.nexus.heart_empty.guide: When consumed, permanently removes 1 heart from the player but grants a hefty dose of experience for your loss.Be careful! You can reduce your hearts permanently down to just one if you keep eating these.
item.nexus.apple_chocolate.guide: Similar to milk, when eaten it clears out potion effects.  However it only removes harmful ones like poison, and not beneficial ones such as regeneration or night vision.
item.nexus.apple_honey.guide: Rich food that has no effects.  Used for crafting.
item.nexus.apple_ender.guide: Eat will show the names a few nearby structures, and their horizontal straight-line distance to your position
item.nexus.apple_diamond.guide: 60 seconds worth of Resistance V and health boost V for short tough fights.  Must be grown and harvested from a sprout
item.nexus.apple_lapis.guide: Utility buffs include swim speed, conduit, water breathing, night vision.
item.nexus.apple_iron.guide: Lower levels of health boost and resistance
item.nexus.apple_emerald.guide: Exlorative buffs include haste, luck, slow falling.  Must be grown and harvested from a sprout
item.nexus.carrot_ender.guide: Give your horse some magic shields.  These trigger when the mount is drowning, falling, burning, or low on health.  When triggered, it will consume one tick of the count and buff the mount accordingly.
item.nexus.toxic_carrot.guide: Use the Toxic Carrot on a horse to turn it into a Zombie Horse.
item.nexus.diamond_carrot_health.guide: Use the Diamond Carrot on a horse to increase its max health.Multiple can be used to increase the horse's max health even more.
item.nexus.redstone_carrot_speed.guide: Use the Redstone Carrot on a horse to increase its top sped.Multiple can be used to increase the top speed even more.
item.nexus.emerald_carrot_jump.guide: Use the Emerald Carrot on a horse to increase its jump height.Multiple can be used to increase the jump height even more.
item.nexus.lapis_carrot_variant.guide: Use the Lapis Carrot on a horse to change its coat to a different variant.Keep using additional Lapis Carrots until you find the coat you're looking for.
item.nexus.inventory_cake.guide: Eating this will unlock a second inventory screen.
item.nexus.inventory_cake.tooltip: Eat to gain a permanent magical backpack
item.nexus.magic_net.tooltip: Charge and throw at a living entity to capture
item.nexus.magic_net.guide: The Monster Ball can be thrown at a creature to capture it. The creature will remain in the ball until you right-click a block with the Monster Ball in hand to release it.An easier alternative to transporting mobs with leashes or minecarts.
item.nexus.mob_container.tooltip: Spawn captured mob from a Monster Ball
item.nexus.mattock_stone.tooltip: 3x3 mining; equal parts shovel and pickaxe
item.nexus.mattock_stone.guide: The Mattock combines the mining capability of a pickaxe with a shovel in a 3x3 pattern that treats dirt and stone type blocks equally.
item.nexus.mattock.tooltip: 3x3 mining; equal parts shovel and pickaxe
item.nexus.mattock.guide: The Mattock combines the mining capability of a pickaxe with a shovel in a 3x3 pattern that treats dirt and stone type blocks equally.
item.nexus.mattock_nether.tooltip: 5x3 mining; equal parts shovel and pickaxe
item.nexus.mattock_nether.guide: The Mattock combines the mining capability of a pickaxe with a shovel in a 5x3 pattern that treats dirt and stone type blocks equally.
item.nexus.lever_remote.tooltip: Bind this to a lever in the world (shift click) to activate it remotely
item.nexus.lever_remote.guide: Remote redstone lever that you bind to a lever in the world by sneaking.  Works across any distance including dimensions if the chunk is loaded.
item.nexus.crystal_gear.guide: Crystallized Obsidian gear is very strong (and very expensive as a result). Much stronger than Netherite gear.
item.nexus.ender_bag.guide: The Ender Bag provides a portable interface to your Ender Chest. Anything you store in your Ender Chest inventory can be accessed via the Ender Bag, and vice versa.
item.nexus.sandstone_gear.guide: The sandstone tools are slightly below stone quality but better than wood.
item.nexus.sandstone_gear.title: Sandstone Gear
item.nexus.sleeping_mat.guide: Use this to make yourself start sleeping right where you stand.  Potion results can be toggled in config. Does not change your respawn point.
item.nexus.soulstone.guide: Triggers the Totem of Undying revival ritual.  Does not have to be held or in your hotbar, just your inventory.  Breaks when durability runs out
item.nexus.soulstone.tooltip: Concentrated essense from Totem of Undying
item.nexus.sprout_seed.guide: Grow a magical plant that gives a random junk or treasure when harvested.
item.nexus.sprout_seed.tooltip: Grow to harvest random junk and treasure
item.nexus.stone_minecart.guide: Think of this as a single-slot chest.  The Stone Minecart can carry any block.  Just use another block or an empty hand to swap blocks in an out (also works with Automated User).  Powered activator rail will pop the block out as well.
item.nexus.stone_minecart.tooltip: Carry one block, unload with activator rail
item.nexus.storage_bag.guide: The Storage Bag can be used as a portable inventory. Right-click with the bag in hand to open it. The bag can be set to pickup items, refill your hotbar, or to deposit its items into any inventory on right-click.
item.nexus.storage_bag.guide0: To change the color of your bag, first open it, pickup some Dye with your mouse, and place it on top of the bag.  This will not consume the dye or move the bag, but it will set the bag item color.
item.nexus.sword_ender.guide: Unbreakable sword with a special right-click ability to launch an ender pearl
item.nexus.sword_slowness.tooltip: Blocking shoots a slowness splash potion
item.nexus.sword_slowness.guide: Unbreakable sword with a special right-click ability to launch a slowness potion
item.nexus.sword_weakness.tooltip: Blocking shoots a weakness splash potion
item.nexus.sword_weakness.guide: Unbreakable sword with a special right-click ability to launch a weakness potion
item.nexus.charm_torch.tooltip: Torches the darkness at your feet while in your inventory
item.nexus.charm_torch.guide: Whenever this detects darkness at your feet, it places a torch there and drains some durability.  Right click in your inventory to turn it off.
item.nexus.charm_torch_cave.tooltip: Torches your dark surroundings while in your inventory
item.nexus.charm_torch_cave.guide: Detects darkness in an area around you and places torches where necessary, draining some durability.  Right click in your inventory to turn it off.
item.nexus.scythe_forage.tooltip: Forage growing resources based on data tag
item.nexus.scythe_forage.guide: Forage growing resources, using the following block data tags:  minecraft:flowers, minecraft:corals, forge:mushrooms, forge:vines, forge:cactus, forge:crop_blocks
item.nexus.scythe_leaves.guide: Harvests all nearby leaves on use, using the forge:leaves block data tag
item.nexus.scythe_brush.tooltip: Harvest weeds based on data tag.
item.nexus.scythe_brush.guide: Harvest everything under the block data tag forge:plants.
item.tool_launcher.tooltip: Hold and use to launch yourself in the selected direction
item.tool_launcher.guide: Aim and then charge this up like a bow and then release it to get launched into the air.  It has two modes, forward and reverse, that you can toggle with attack (left-click).  Forward means you need to aim up into the air, and you fly the exact direction and angle that you look.  Reverse means you have to aim down at the ground and you get launched backwards.  Using this gives you the "bouncy" potion effect, which makes anything you land on bounce you up like a slime block.
item.tool_mount.guide: Mount any entity that is not normally mountable.
item.nexus.stirrups.tooltip: Mount any entity (without the control of the saddle)
item.nexus.stirrups.guide: Mount any entity (without the control of the saddle)
item.nexus.stirrups_reverse.guide: Pickup target entity on top of you.  Use it on the mob again to put down
item.nexus.mount_inverse.tooltip: Pickup a living entity and mount it on your head.
item.nexus.mount_inverse.guide: Pickup a living entity and mount it on your head.
item.nexus.prospector.guide: Searches out for ores behind the block you click on.  Uses the forge:ores block tag
item.nexus.push.guide: This tool has three modes: Push, Pull, Rotate.  Change mode using attack (Left-Click).  Push and pull work similar to a piston, moving the block as long as there is an air block where it is moving; and it also moves tile entities with their data (full chests/furnaces/etc).  Rotate mode will try to spin the block around on its axis, such as log positioning, or halfslabs and stairs moving to alternate orientations.
item.nexus.randomize.guide: This will mixup the blocks in the nearby area, to help you vary the texture of your wall or pathway.  Use the attack (Left-Click) to change size.  It affects a flat area along the face of whatever you hit.  Tile entities are ignored (chests and so on).
item.nexus.randomize.tooltip: Randomize selected blocks.  Left click to resize.
item.nexus.rotate.guide: Attempts to rotate the targeted block while respecting the same material type.  So it will turn a log to a different angle, but will not turn oak planks into spruce planks.  This can be used to get vanilla only blocks that are otherwise un-obainable blocks, like smooth stone double slabs with the flat side, extra smooth sandstone, and a log with bark on all six sides.
item.nexus.rotate.tooltip: Rotates simple blocks/machines if they are able
item.nexus.spawn_inspector.guide: Tells you exactly which mobs can spawn on the targeted block.  Natural spawns only, ignores mob spawner blocks.  Useful for making slime, witch, and wither skeleton farms.
item.nexus.spawn_inspector.tooltip: Detects mob spawns (including modded, slimes, and Wither skeletons)
item.nexus.spawn_inspector.up: Click on the top side of a block
item.nexus.spelunker.guide: Searches out for empty space behind the block you click on.  Works in any direction.  If you hit the top of a block it searches down, if you hit the side it searches behind.  Always in a straight line.  Great for finding caves while branch mining.
item.nexus.torch_launcher.tooltip: Spawns in a torch wherever it lands
item.nexus.torch_launcher.guide: The Torch Launcher shoots a torch with considerable force in the direction you are facing, placing the torch wherever it lands.Automatically consumes torches in your inventory to refill itself.
item.nexus.trade.tooltip: Opens an improved trading interface with the closest villager
item.nexus.trade.guide: Use near a villager for an advanced trading menu.  Has convenience buttons that perform one trade with each click.  Fully respects all villager trading rules, mechanics, locks, and unlocks.
item.nexus.charm_home.tooltip: Teleport to your personal spawn point
item.nexus.charm_home.guide: Warps you back home at cost of durability. If you have an active Respawn Anchor in the Nether and you are currently in the Nether, you will be teleported there.Otherwise, you will be teleported to your bed if you are in the Overworld and you have slept in a bed to set your respawn point.
item.nexus.charm_world.guide: Warps you to world spawn at the cost of durability.
item.nexus.wand_hypno.guide: Confuse nearby hostiles so they attack each other
item.nexus.wand_hypno.tooltip: Confuse nearby hostiles so they attack each other
item.nexus.wand_missile.guide: Spawns homing missiles at nearby hostile targets
item.nexus.wand_missile.tooltip: Spawns homing missiles at nearby hostile targets
item.nexus.spell_ice.guide: Turns nearby water blocks into ice.  Costs durability to use.
item.nexus.spell_water.tooltip: Replace nearby flowing water with source water
item.nexus.spell_water.guide: Turns nearby flowing water into source water.  Fills lakes and rivers out very quickly.
item.nexus.teleport_wand.tooltip: Teleports where you look, using Ender Pearls as fuel
item.nexus.teleport_wand.guide: The Ender Scepter when held and charged, can be used to teleport large distances to the block that you're looking at. Automatically consumes Ender Pearls in your inventory to repair itself.
item.nexus.elevation_wand.tooltip: Teleport yourself or the target entity up to the nearest surface above
item.nexus.elevation_wand.guide: Teleporter that works only vertically, and only if it can find an empty space with a surface above.  Works on yourself, or target another entity.
item.nexus.antimatter_wand.guide: Left-click to cycle between Water, Lava, and Generic Fluid modes. Right-click to clear a 9x9 area of the selected fluid type from the world.
nexus.unlocks.extended: Unlocked Extended Inventory - see Key Bindings to open
nexus.unlocks.extended.locked: Extended Inventory still locked - eat the cake
block.nexus.crafter.guide: Set the recipe, and this will autocraft as many as it can.  Input slots are on the left slots, outputs on the right.  Also works with pipes/cables/hoppers for input and output
block.nexus.beacon.tooltip: Use potions to generate beacon effects
block.nexus.beacon.guide: The Pharos Beacon takes power and potions as input and automatically applies potion effects to the selected type of entity in a radius around itself. Can target players, mobs, animals, etc. If Entity data card is present, it is also applied along with the button filter together.
block.nexus.anti_beacon.tooltip: Cures most harmful potion effects nearby
block.nexus.anti_beacon.guide: Nearby potions get cleared every few ticks, and on placement.  Many settings for this are in the config file.
block.nexus.beacon_redstone.guide: Displays a beacon beam when powered with redstone.  No potion effects of any kind
block.nexus.beacon_redstone.tooltip: Displays a beacon beam when powered with redstone
block.nexus.disenchanter.guide: The Disenchanter can take an enchantment off of an item and apply it to a book. Only one enchantment is stripped at a time, so items with multiple enchantments will need to be disenchanted multiple times.
block.nexus.anvil.guide: The Powered Diamond Anvil repairs equipment using Energy
block.nexus.anvil_magma.guide: The Magma Anvil repairs equipment using liquid Magma.  Pipe it in from a tank or something else
block.nexus.enchanter.tooltip: Add enchantments using experience fluid and energy
block.nexus.enchanter.guide: Feed in experience as a fluid, and then add any enchantable item. Can be automated with pipes & hoppers.
block.nexus.fisher.tooltip: Fishes in nearby water using a fishing rod
block.nexus.fisher.guide: Place in water and give it a fishing rod and it will automatically catch fish.Caught fish will be dropped in the world and need to be picked up manually or by other machines.
block.nexus.scaffold.guide.title: Angel Scaffolding
block.nexus.scaffold.guide: Scaffolding is a cheap, easy to break block that can be used when building. All Scaffolding can be placed in mid-air and climbed like a ladder.
block.nexus.scaffold_fragile.tooltip: Angel placement in mid-air; Decays over time
block.nexus.scaffold_responsive.tooltip: Angel placement in mid-air; Use a block on this to replace it
block.nexus.scaffold_responsive.guide: Use a block on this to replace it.
block.nexus.scaffold_replace.tooltip: Angel placement in mid-air; Use a block on this to replace it
block.nexus.scaffold_replace.guide: Use a block on this to replace it.
block.nexus.tank.tooltip: Stores up to 64 buckets of any liquid
block.nexus.tank.guide: The Fluid Storage Tank is the big brother of the Cask, able to store more fluid in a single block.
block.nexus.user.tooltip: Autonomous right-click activation using any item
block.nexus.user.guide: The Item User is a powerful machine that uses the item given to it to right click the block in front of it with a configurable delay.
enchantment_stack.empty: Empty; use an enchanted book to store
block.nexus.screen.guide: Like a slightly advanced computerized sign, used to project text into the world.Projected text may extend beyond the edges of the screen.
block.nexus.screen_target.tooltip: Display properties of a distant block
block.nexus.screen_target.guide: Target a block with a GPS marker, and you can display its fluid, energy, or item content
nexus.gui.sliderkeys: Mouse wheel; Arrow keys & hold shift/alt
block.nexus.library_ctrl.tooltip: Surround this with Ender Bookshelves to deposit
block.nexus.library_ctrl.guide: The controller block for Ender Bookshelves.  Surround it with Ender Bookshelves so it can connect and it will distribute enchantments.  Can be automated by piping in enchanted books and pulling out empty books.
block.nexus.library.tooltip: Four drawers of deep enchantment storage
block.nexus.library.guide: Use enchanted books on any corner.  Each corner stores many copies of that same enchantment.  Use a book on it to withdraw.  Hold a Redstone Torch in your hand and hit it to toggle display modes.
block.nexus.structure.guide: This advanced building machine has a fixed set of shapes such as Pyramid, Sphere, Cylander, etc.  Using power and blocks you can build any shape with this.  Also can use Shape Data Cards for custom shapes.
block.builder_pattern.flip: Flip Regions (purple is source, white is target)
block.builder_pattern.guide: This advanced building machine can copy almost anything.  Select two nearby regions of the world of equal size and shape, give it materials, and it will copy the build from one area to the other.
block.builder_pattern.tooltip: Copy and paste the selected area using supplied materials
block.nexus.clock.tooltip: Clock with time and power controls
block.nexus.clock.guide: The Redstone Clock emits a redstone signal with a configurable delay, length, and signal.Useful for contraptions that need to work on a timer.
block.nexus.detector_entity.tooltip: Detect entities nearby and output redstone
block.nexus.detector_entity.guide: Detect entities nearby and outputs a redstone signal when detected. The detection range, type of entity, amount, and comparison type are configurable from its GUI.
nexus.detector.compare.tooltip: How to compare count to the limit
block.nexus.detector_item.tooltip: Detect items nearby and output redstone
block.nexus.detector_item.guide: Detect items nearby and outputs a redstone signal. The range and comparison method are configurable in its GUI.
block.nexus.fire_dark.tooltip: Does not harm players or destroy blocks
block.nexus.harvester.guide: The Harvester will gently farm crops in an area in front of it, replanting the seeds (if any) after breaking the crop.
block.nexus.magnet_anti_block.guide: This repels hostile entities away from it every few ticks.
block.nexus.magnet_anti_block.tooltip: Repels mobs every $t$ ticks with range $r$
block.nexus.magnet_block.guide: Attracts nearby items on the ground.  Interact to toggle on and off.  Intended to help with early game automation
block.nexus.password_block.activetype.to: Switch between On/Off and Pulse mode
block.nexus.password_block.guide: Use this to trigger a redstone signal or pulse from far away.  It triggers when the password you set is seen in chat, at which point the chat display is cancelled.  You can also claim ownership to prevent the password working for other players.
block.nexus.password_block.triggered: Password Block triggered; chat message cancelled:
block.nexus.password_block.triggeredmany: Password Blocks triggered; chat message cancelled:
block.nexus.password_block.userclaim.too: Only the owner of the block can change the password
Who can active this block with the password
block.nexus.placer.guide: Places a block from its inventory in the direction it is facing.
block.nexus.plate_launch.guide: The Bounce Plate Launches any entity that touches it into the air.
block.nexus.plate_launch_redstone.toolti: Launch entities based on redstone power value
block.nexus.plate_launch_redstone.guide: The Bounce Plate Launches any entity that touches it into the air with magnitude that increases as the provided redstone signal increases.
block.nexus.plate_vector.guide: This is a combination of a jump pad and a conveyor, you can configure its strength and angle in the GUI.  Once configured, it saves data into the item, and you can tap it on any other plate to copy the configration into it.
block.nexus.plate_vector.tooltip.button: Yaw is the horizontal aim, Pitch is the vertical aim, and Strength affects the distance
block.nexus.spikes.guide: Spikes can be placed in the world in any orientation to damage creatures or players that touch them. Spikes are only extended when they receive a redstone signal.
block.nexus.spikes_iron.tooltip: Powered by redstone; damage on contact
block.nexus.spikes_fire.tooltip: Powered by redstone; burns on contact
block.nexus.spikes_curse.tooltip: Powered by redstone; curses on contact
block.nexus.spikes_curse.guide: Curses enemies with various negative effects on contact.
block.nexus.spikes_diamond.tooltip: Powered by redstone; damage on contact
block.nexus.spikes_diamond.guide: Damage entities on contact.  Attacks using a fake player to trigger loot tables
block.nexus.sprinkler.guide: This only runs while water is inside the internal tank (fill with a bucket or pipes).  It will water nearby crops, increasing their growing speed.  Consumes water source blocks from below.  Multiple sprinklers in the same area do stack.
block.nexus.sprinkler.tooltip: Consumes water and grows nearby crops
block.nexus.sprout.guide: When this is harvested it randomly drops a block from a custom loot table (listed in config file)
block.nexus.uncrafter.notenoughitems: Not enough items to satisfy recipe
block.nexus.uncrafter.guide: This will lookup and reverse any vanilla 2x2 or 3x3 recipe.  May not work with specialized modded recipes / machine recipes.
block.nexus.wireless_redstone.guide: The Wireless Redstone Transmitter and Receiver allow you to transmit redstone signals between distant points.Place a Wireless Receiver in the world and use a GPS Marker on it to store its coordinates. Then insert the GPS Marker into a Redstone Transmitter.Anytime the Transmitter receives a redstone signal, it will cause all linked Receivers to receive the same signal.
block.nexus.wireless_transmitter.tooltip: Transmit wireless redstone to any compatible block
block.nexus.wireless_transmitter.guide: The Wireless Redstone Transmitter and Receiver allow you to transmit redstone signals between distant points.Place a Wireless Receiver in the world and use a GPS Marker on it to store its coordinates. Then insert the GPS Marker into a Redstone Transmitter.Anytime the Transmitter receives a redstone signal, it will cause all linked Receivers to receive the same signal.
block.nexus.wireless_receiver.guide: The Wireless Redstone Transmitter and Receiver allow you to transmit redstone signals between distant points.Place a Wireless Receiver in the world and use a GPS Marker on it to store its coordinates. Then insert the GPS Marker into a Redstone Transmitter.Anytime the Transmitter receives a redstone signal, it will cause all linked Receivers to receive the same signal.
block.nexus.wireless_receiver.tooltip: Receive wireless redstone signals from a Transmitter
potion.butter.oops: Butterfingers!  Dropped something when you moved.
effect.nexus.flight.description: Players can fly using this effect
item.nexus.tile_transporter_empty.guide: Right click on any machine or container with the Sack of Holding to pick it up.  Right click on any block with a filled Sack of Holding to place the machine again.
effect.nexus.butter.description: Chance to drop items while moving or attacking
effect.nexus.waterwalk.description: Prevents you from sinking down through the waters surface
effect.nexus.magnetic.description: Pull items and XP towards you with range of 8 blocks per level
effect.nexus.snowwalk.description: Leave a tralk of snow when you walk
effect.nexus.antigravity.description: You partially resist the force of gravity.  Low levels feel like the moon, higher levels get dangerous
effect.nexus.gravity.description: Increases the force of gravity you feel
effect.nexus.attack_range.description: Increases your melee attack range by factor of two
effect.nexus.reach_distance.description: Increase block placement and mining reach by factor of two
item.minecraft.potion.effect.nexus_haste: The Potion of Haste apples the Haste effect to the target, increasing their mining speed.
item.minecraft.potion.effect.nexus_swims: The Potion of Swim Speed greatly increases its target's speed while moving through liquids.
effect.nexus.freeze.description: Freeze the entity so it cannot move for a time
item.minecraft.potion.effect.nexus_freez: Completely immobilizes its target for a brief period.
block.nexus.placer_fluid.guide: The Fluid Placer places fluid from its internal tank in the direction it is facing, if possible.
block.nexus.pipe.guide.title: Cables
block.nexus.pipe.guide: Types of cables can be used to transport fluids, items, or energy between machines. They can be configured using a Cable Wrench.
block.nexus.fluid_pipe.tooltip: Pipe liquid between blocks; use a Cable Wrench to customize
block.nexus.fluid_pipe.tooltip0: Also collects fluid source blocks from the world
block.nexus.fluid_pipe.guide: Pipe liquid between blocks.  Has extraction mode with a filter GUI, and a yellow blocked state to disable the flow.  Also collects fluid from the world.  Shift-left-click to set and remove blocks to cover the pipe as a Facade
block.nexus.energy_pipe.tooltip: Pipe energy between blocks; use a Cable Wrench to customize
block.nexus.energy_pipe.guide: Pipe energy between blocks.  Has extraction mode with a filter GUI, and a yellow blocked state to disable the flow.  Shift-left-click to set and remove blocks to cover the pipe as a Facade
block.nexus.item_pipe.tooltip: Pipe items between blocks; use a Cable Wrench to customize
block.nexus.item_pipe.guide: Pipe items between blocks.  Has extraction mode with a filter GUI, and a yellow blocked state to disable the flow.  Shift-left-click to set and remove blocks to cover the pipe as a Facade
block.nexus.item_pipe_sort.tooltip: Sorting machine for use with cables and hoppers
block.nexus.item_pipe_sort.filter: Output here only if it matches this filter
block.nexus.item_pipe_sort.everything: Output everything here, ignoring this filter
block.nexus.item_pipe_sort.nothing: Output nothing here, ignoring this filter
item.nexus.biomass.guide: Combine with various organic material in a Melter to create Fluid Biomass
item.nexus.peat_fuel.tooltip: Smelted peat.  Use in a generator.
item.nexus.peat_fuel.guide: Peat Fuel is smelted from Saturated Peat Deposits and used in a Generator to generate energy.It can also be combined with  Fluid Biomass in a Solidification Chamber to create Enriched Peat.
item.nexus.peat_fuel_enriched.guide: Created by combining Peat with Fluid Biomass in a Solidification Chamber and used to provide even more power in a Generator.
block.nexus.peat_unbaked.tooltip: Slowly turns into a Peat Deposit when sitting in water
block.nexus.peat_unbaked.guide: Dry Peat Bog, when placed next to water, will slowly turn into a Saturated Peat Deposit, which can be smelted to create fuel for the Generator.
block.nexus.peat_baked.tooltip: Wet peat ready to be harvested and smelted
block.nexus.peat_baked.guide: Saturated Peat Deposits form over time when Dry Peat Bog is placed next to water. Once harvested, it can be smelted to create fuel for the Generator.
block.nexus.generator_fuel.tooltip: Generate power from anything that burns as fuel in Furnaces
block.nexus.generator_fuel.guide: Generate power from anything that burns as fuel in Furnaces.  Burn time is the same number of ticks as the furnace time, for example 1 coal = 1600 ticks.  Energy per ticks is in the config file, defaults to 80 RF/t
block.nexus.generator_solar.guide: Generates small amounts of energy when in direct sunlight
block.nexus.generator_food.tooltip: Generate power from anything that can be eaten
block.nexus.generator_food.guide: Generate power from food type items.  Burn time and energy per tick are set up in the config file.  It uses both food and saturation values multiplied by a factor.  Energy speed defaults to 80 RF/t
block.nexus.generator_item.tooltip: Breaks down matter to generate energy
block.nexus.generator_item.guide: Generate power from certain mob drop items.  All energy producing recipes are set in the JSON datapack; for example a default recipe breaks down Ender Pearls for 100 RF/t
block.nexus.generator_fluid.guide: Evaporate liquids to generate energy.  All recipes are defined in the JSON datapack; one of the default recipes produces lava at 80 RF/t.
block.nexus.peat_farm.guide: The Peat Farm takes water and Dry Peat Bog as its inputs and automatically builds a 15x15 Peat Bog farm surrounding itself.When Dry Peat Bog becomes saturated, the Peat Farm will automatically harvest it and place more Dry Peat Bog in its place.
block.nexus.miner.tooltip: Mines a configurable area in front of the Miner
block.nexus.miner.guide: Mines a configurable area in front of the Miner. Will attempt to mine with any tool you provide it.  See Blockstate Data Card
block.nexus.forester.guide: The Forester will attempt to place saplings in the area in front of itself, and harvest them when the saplings grow into trees.
block.nexus.dropper.guide: Drops blocks from its internal buffer at a configurable stack size, distance, and delay.
block.nexus.battery.guide: Stores Forge Energy (FE) to be used in machines. Power can be transferred to and from the battery via cables or by placing machines directly adjacent to the battery.
block.nexus.item_infinite.guide: Duplicate items for pack testing.  Add an item with your hand or a hopper, then pull it out with another and it repeats itself including NBT and damage
block.fire_dark.guide: Does not destroy blocks or harm players.  Spawned by Duskflame Hex
block.target.tooltip: Emits redstone based on where the arrow lands
block.target.guide: Emits redstone based on where the arrow lands.  Only works on the side, not top or bottom.
block.moon_sensor.tooltip: Emits signal based on current moons phase
block.moon_sensor.guide: Emits signal based on current moons phase.  Power ranges along 1,3,5,7,9,11,13,15 and back down again.  Stays powered during the day, and changes every night as the moon shifts phases.
item.robot_spawner.tooltip: [EXPERIMENTAL FEATURE] Spawn a Target Dummy Spawner that measures damage done by a player
item.robot_spawner.guide: Spawn a Target Dummy Spawner that measures damage done by a player.  Can be given armor that will affect damage taken, and drop on death.  Has no movement or attacks.  Can be killed, or removed instantly by using the spawner on it again.
block.fire_starter.tooltip: Use flint to start a fire on signal
block.fire_starter.guide: Use flint to start a fire on redsotne signal.  Can face any direction.  Chance to consume flint.
block.fire_frost.tooltip: Low intermittent damage; slowness and weakness
block.fire_frost.guide: Low intermittent damage; slowness and weakness
block.nexus.anvil_void.guide: Delete enchantments off anything by wiping out the enchantments NBT tag.  Uses no power
block.sound_player.guide: Can play almost any non-record sound on redstone signal.  Be careful playing music tracks over and over, they can will overlap.
item.sign_editor.tooltip: Edit sign text, colour, and font
item.sign_editor.guide: Edit sign text, color, and font.  Save data in the sign is fully vanilla compatible, same NBT tags as command blocks when they set colour.
gui.signs.title: Signpost Customization
block.nexus.dice.guide: When placed or clicked, the Dice will roll and show a new random number from 1-6.
item.nexus.laser_cannon.guide: Only fires when there is a living target.  Press and hold to shoot
item.nexus.laser_cannon.notarget: No target found, firing process uninitiated
block.imbuer.tooltip: Imbue your bow with secret powers
block.imbuer.guide: Imbue your bow with secret powers.  Place in an ingredient and a bow, and then apply a redstone signal.  Sneak right-click while it is empty to list valid recipes.
item.nexus.slingshot.guide: Charge like a bow.  Ammunition is built in, so it simply consumes durability.
item.nexus.netherbrick_gear.guide.title: Nether Gear
item.nexus.netherbrick_gear.guide: Nether gear is slightly stronger than Stone gear.
item.nexus.creative_sword.tooltip: One hit to destroy everything, Only for creative.
item.nexus.creative_sword.guide: One hit to destroy everything, Only for creative.
wireless.empty: Bind a location to a GPS Marker
chest_sack.error.pickup: Error detected when attempting pickup - action cancelled (see logs for details)
chest_sack.error.place: Error detected when attempting to place - action cancelled (see logs for details)
block.nexus.packager.guide: Package matching items together.  Compatible with all 2x2, 3x3 recipes that are specifically merging identical items together such as Iron Blocks or Bricks
block.dehydrator.guide: Dehydrate certain items.  Add more recipes using CraftTweaker.  Lava is optional but will increase processing speed.
block.nexus.shearing.tooltip: Shears sheep like mobs on contact
block.nexus.shearing.guide: Shears sheep for wool when touched.  Block has no durability like the shears item.  Works on all compatible mobs, not only Sheep, using IForgeShearable
item.nexus.shears_obsidian.guide: Obsidian Shears are like regular shears... but they last longer. A lot longer.
item.nexus.shears_flint.guide: Flint Shears break more quickly than regular shears, but they are easier to craft in the early-game.
item.nexus.boomerang.guide.title: Boomerang
item.nexus.boomerang.guide: Boomerangs are a multipurpose tool for gathering items. Simply hold it in your hand, lock on, and throw! If any items are along its path, they will be picked up and brought to the thrower.
item.nexus.boomerang_carry.tooltip: Throw to gather items that it returns to you
item.nexus.boomerang_carry.guide: Throw to gather items that it returns to you
item.nexus.boomerang_freeze.tooltip: Gathers items and freeze your enemies
item.nexus.boomerang_freeze.guide: Gathers items and freeze your enemies
item.nexus.boomerang_damage.tooltip: Gathers items and attacks your enemies
item.nexus.boomerang_damage.guide: Gathers items and attacks your enemies
block.nexus.laser.guide: Use GPS Markers to target lasers and heavily customize their appearance.
block.water_candle.guide: Light with flint and steel.  Greatly increases natural mobs spawns nearby.  Follows normal spawning rules of mobs and biome.  Has a chance of being extinguished on every spawn.  Many propertes in config file.
block.nexus.collector_fluid.tooltip: Collect nearby fluid to an internal tank
block.nexus.collector_fluid.guide: The Fluid Collector collects fluid from the area in front of and below it, replacing the collected fluids with blocks from its internal buffer. Will not collect fluid unless it has replacement blocks in its buffer, to prevent lag.
block.nexus.melter.guide: The Melter, as its name implies, melts ingredients into various liquids using energy.
block.nexus.solidifier.guide: The Solidifier combines various fluids and ingredients to solidify them into something else, usually to make new crafting ingredients.
